checks.name: undamped amplitude and signed initial velocity
checks.detail: A√2,θ=-π/4,ω2 reconstruct x0=1,v0=2. A and x0 alone allow ±v0; zero amplitude has arbitrary phase. k/m has units s^-2 and ω has rad/s.

checks.name: physical versus mass-normalized coefficients
checks.detail: Critical physical c8kg/s for m2kg,k8N/m; mass-normalized code k4,c4. Quadruple k with fixed m doubles frequency, not quadruples it.

checks.name: underdamped solution and differential equation
checks.detail: ω0=4,ζ=.25 givesωd=√15; initial position/velocity and x″+ω0²x+2ζω0x′=0 independently checked. ζ0 has no decay; ζ1 requires its own limit formula.

checks.name: critical damping can cross the target once
checks.detail: x=(1-8t)e^-2t with x0=1,v0=-10 crosses at.125s. Nonoscillatory does not guarantee no overshoot for arbitrary initial velocity.

checks.name: overdamped real roots and initial conditions

detail.assumptions: Positive m,k,c; comparison depends on initial conditions and criterion. No blanket fastest/no-overshoot guarantee.

checks.name: viscous damping dissipates energy
checks.detail: For fixed rest position,m1,k16,c2: d(.5mv²+.5kx²)/dt=-cv². A moving set point can supply energy; do not extrapolate autonomous decay to arbitrary inputs.

checks.name: semi-implicit Euler does not inherit unconditional stability

detail.codeOrder: velocity+=accel*dt; position+=updatedVelocity*dt. Continuous critical damping is stable, butdt1 discrete update diverges.

checks.name: first-order lag sign and constant-target composition
checks.detail: Positiveλ with x′=-λx decays. Exact qnew=r+(q-r)e^-λdt is independent of step subdivision for a fixed target; changing targets are a different forcing problem. A first-order filter has no separate velocity state.

clarifications: Hooke signed force is different from its magnitude; nonsingular spring direction and elastic range need guards.
k1/k2 integration constants are not the physical spring constant k.
Set point derivatives affect whether D uses value velocity or error velocity; the historical code damps value velocity.
PID integral action removes steady bias only under suitable stable control assumptions; no universal guarantee.
Nearζ1 avoid evaluating an underdamped expression with vanishingωd as a numerically safe universal solution.
Zero k/m,negative damping and arbitrary changing inputs require separate handling.
No named-game camera spring implementation is inferred from a gameplay shot.
